_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: clinic risk = arm risk (0.35 control, 0.20 intervention) + a symmetric clinic shift

agreement.claim: both engines report the same difference and t interval
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0 at ten significant digits. harness/longitudinal_examples.test.py checks against the pooled-variance t formula and shows that treating the 1440 patients as independent gives an interval of half-width 0.044 against the cluster-level 0.068.

recovery.claim: the difference in mean cluster proportion is close to the fixture's

calibration.limits: With 16 clusters and a difference of 0.10, the miss equalled the effect; with 24 clusters and a difference of 0.15 it is 0.089. Few clusters estimate imprecisely, whatever the method.
